summary: Iter 282 Org Chart Publish & Share — full end-to-end pass. Backend pytest GREEN; frontend Share modal, publish/copy/open/rotate/unpublish, header 'Share'→'Shared'→'Share' label state, /org/{token} public render (no login), rotate-invalidates-old-token, and unpublish-shows-gone-state all verified on the live preview URL with admin@gymaxisai.com.
critical_code_review_comments: ShareModal toggleContact silently swallows publish() errors (catch /* ignore */). If the show_contact API call fails the UI checkbox still flips without rollback or toast — low priority but worth surfacing an error.
PublicOrgChartPage axios call has no abort/cleanup in useEffect; if the user navigates away mid-fetch React will warn about state updates on unmounted component (cosmetic).
Resize/scale recompute on PublicOrgChartPage runs only once after status===ok; window-resize will not re-fit the chart. Minor UX nit.
seed_data_creation: Used the existing GymAxis 'Organisation Chart' (13 people) auto-created on first open — no extra template applied.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend publish/public/rotate/unpublish endpoints sanitise email/phone/notes/salary/staff_id correctly (covered in test_iter282_orgchart_share.py). The chart's public_token persists across tests — Share button may already read 'Shared' on entry; the modal will open in published state, so the test must branch on whether [data-testid=orgchart-share-publish] exists. /org/:token route is lazy-loaded — wait ~5–7s before asserting public-orgchart-page or public-orgchart-gone. Use viewport 1920x1080 and ignore CSP errors for assets.emergent.sh/posthog/cloudflareinsights.
rca of the issue: N/A — feature works as specified. All five test scenarios from the review request pass end-to-end on the public preview URL.
